weapons.name: CROSS Magnum Bolt-Action Rifle
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification table for SKU CROSS-MAG-300WM-24B, row pairs: 'BARREL LENGTH 24 in [609.6 mm]' and 'TWIST RATE 1:9'. 1 turn in 9 in = 228.6 mm. Read from the rendered specification list on the SIG SAUER product page captured by the Internet Archive (no wording rendered as a sentence; the value is the label/value pair 'TWIST RATE' / '1:9').

weapons.name: P220 Pistol
weapons.source_note: Section 12.2, 'P220 Technical Specifications': 'P220 Type Super Match Match Elite / Caliber .45 ACP .45 ACP .45 ACP / ... / Barrel Length 5.0" 5.0" 4.4" / Rifling Twist 1 in 16" 1 in 16" 1 in 16"'. All three .45 ACP P220 variants are listed as 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm. The table states no groove count for the P220.

weapons.name: P229 Pistol, .40 S&W variant
weapons.source_note: Section 12.12, 'P229 Technical Specifications': 'Caliber 9mm .40 S&W 357 SIG ... Barrel Length 3.9" 3.9" 3.9" / Rifling Twist 1 in 10" 1 in 15" 1 in 16" / Rifling Grooves 6 6 6'. The .40 S&W column is 1 turn in 15 in = 381.0 mm, 6 grooves. (Note: the separate 12.14 P229 Carry table lists .40 S&W as '1:16 LH'; the standard P229 .40 S&W barrel is 1 in 15 in.)

weapons.name: SG 551 Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: Section 2.3.1 'SG 551 SB Picatinny version' technical specifications: 'Barrel / Barrel length.....mm...363 / Number of grooves..........6 / Rifling / SG 551-1.....inches. ...10 / SG 551-2.....inches. ......7'. Repeated identically for the SG 551 SB Diopter, SG 551 LB Picatinny and SG 551 LB Diopter versions. The manufacturer lists TWO barrel variants: SG 551-1 is 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm, SG 551-2 is 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm. The recorded value is the SG 551-1 barrel. Do not treat 254.0 mm as covering the SG 551-2 barrel.

weapons.name: SG 552 Commando Carbine
weapons.source_note: 'Technical Data SG 551 SWAT - SG 552 Commando': 'SG 552 Commando ... Calibre 5.56 x 45 mm / .223 Remington ... Barrel length 226 mm / Rifling lead 7" / Number of grooves 6'. The page states the data is 'Information courtesy of SAN Swiss Arms AG'. 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm, 6 grooves.

weapons.name: SIG 556 Export Semi-Automatic Rifle
weapons.source_note: Section 2.2 'Technical Specifications' of the SIG 556 operator manual: 'Caliber 5.56mm NATO (.223 Remington) / Total length 37 inches / Length with stock collapsed 33.5 inches / Barrel length 16 inches / Number of grooves 6 / Rifling 1 in 7'. 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm, 6 grooves. The manual cover reads 'SIG 556 SEMI-AUTOMATIC RIFLE 5.56mm NATO (.223 Remington)'.

weapons.name: SSG 3000 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Section 4.0 'Technical specifications': 'Caliber 7.62 mm x 51 NATO (.308 Win.) ... Rifling twist 1:12" / 305 mm ... Barrel length, excl. flash suppressor 23.50" / 600 mm / No. of grooves 4'. 1 turn in 12 in = 304.8 mm, 4 grooves.

weapons.name: Maxim 50 Muzzleloader
weapons.source_note: SPECS page of the SilencerCo Maxim 50 instruction manual: 'The Maxim 50 is an inline muzzleloader with the following specs: / 45" Overall Length / 20" Barrel Length / 9" Moderator Length / Tac2 Trigger System ... / .50 Caliber / 1:28" Rate-Of-Twist'. 1 turn in 28 in = 711.2 mm. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: Model 442 J-frame Airweight
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification sheet, SKU 150544, 'J-FRAME MODEL 442 AIRWEIGHT - LIGHTWEIGHT ALUMINUM ALLOY FRAME': '38 SPECIAL +P | 1.88" | 5-rounds' and the Barrel Details cell '1.88" (4.78 cm) Stainless steel, 1:18.75" Twist rate'. 1 turn in 18.75 in = 476.25 mm. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: Model 642 J-frame Airweight
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification sheet, SKU 14925, 'J-FRAME MODEL 642 AMERICA 250 EDITION ... NO INTERNAL LOCK DOUBLE-ACTION ONLY': '14925 | 38 SPECIAL +P | 1.875" | 5-rounds' and the Barrel Details cell '1:18.75" Twist rate'. 1 turn in 18.75 in = 476.25 mm. This sheet is for the Model 642 America 250th Limited Edition, the 1.875 in .38 Special +P J-frame Airweight that matches this entry. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: Model 629 N-frame Revolver
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification sheet, 'SPECIAL MAKE-UP MODEL 629': 'Chambered in .44 Magnum with a 6.5" barrel' and the Barrel cell '1:20" Twist rate'. 1 turn in 20 in = 508.0 mm. The sheet covers a Model 629 (engraved), .44 Magnum, 6.5 in barrel, which matches this entry. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: M&P45 M2.0 Full-Size Pistol
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification sheet, SKU 12637, 'M&P 45 M2.0 - LAW ENFORCEMENT - NIGHT SIGHTS': '45 AUTO | 4.6" | 10+1-rounds' and the Rifling column '1:15" Twist'. 1 turn in 15 in = 381.0 mm. The sheet is for the M&P45 M2.0 full-size LE variant, the 4.6 in .45 ACP pistol of this entry. Groove count not stated.

weapons.name: SW1911 E-Series Pistol
weapons.source_note: Parts listing for the Smith & Wesson OEM barrel, part 275500000: 'Authentic OEM factory new 5" stainless steel barrel for the Smith & Wesson 1911 Government model pistol. Features a 1-in-16" twist rate optimized for .45 ACP, machined to factory specification for a drop-in fit on S&W 1911 Government frames.' Part table: 'Brand: Smith & Wesson / Caliber: .45 ACP / Barrel Length: 5" / Twist Rate: 1 in 16"'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm. This is the factory barrel used by the SW1911 E-Series (5 in, .45 ACP); Smith & Wesson does not publish a twist figure on the model product page or its 2011 model spec sheet.
